question:
Arrange the following fractions in ascending order.

5/9, 8/3, 7/5, 3/5, 1/9
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Convert the given fractions into percentages or decimals for instant comparison.

1/9 ≈ 11.11% | 5/9 ≈ 55.55% | 3/5 = 60%

7/5 = 140% | 8/3 ≈ 266.66%
